scope: Observational summaries preserve all 600 actual World records including the budget-exhausted run; they do not waive the formal rejection. No unknown final outcome is classified as death or victory.
limitations: Deterministic policy outcomes are not human completion rates.
TTK is birth-to-death active player-clock time including approach; surviving enemies are censored. Histogram rank intervals are not exact median lifetimes.
Birth stars include every role, fixed miniboss stars, main bosses, escorts and summons; fusion promotions are not births. This mixture is not a native-weight probability estimate.
Idle means no live enemy or chest at a Playing step start, including designed breaks and death animation; presentation seconds are separate.
